name: synx-monorepo
description: Synx – watch Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts together, perfectly in sync

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck
scripts.app:tunnel: npm --prefix app run build:agent && cd app && npx expo start --tunnel
